proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Sec. 704, what is the relationship between the 50% opening limitation and the 10% natural ventilation requirement of Rule VIII, Sec. 811?

options.text: The 10% ventilation requirement overrides the 50% opening cap, so any window satisfying Rule VIII automatically complies with Sec. 704, which simplifies design considerations

The two requirements create potential tension on narrow lots; designers must resolve this by mechanical ventilation, facade orientation, or demonstrating the 10% ventilation is achievable within the 50% cap
Rule VIII ventilation requirements are waived for buildings in Fire Restrictive Zones, which allows for greater design flexibility
There is no interaction — the two rules govern completely different building aspects with no overlap, simplifying compliance
